description: Source code implementing comparison and retrieval functions for X509 certificates and related structures in OpenSSL/Boringssl.

methods.name: X509_issuer_name_cmp
methods.description: Compares the issuer names of two X509 certificates.

methods.name: X509_subject_name_cmp
methods.description: Compares the subject names of two X509 certificates.

methods.name: X509_CRL_cmp
methods.description: Compares the issuer names of two X509 CRLs.

methods.name: X509_CRL_match
methods.description: Compares the hashes of two X509 CRLs.

methods.name: X509_get_issuer_name
methods.description: Retrieves the issuer name from an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_issuer_name_hash
methods.description: Calculates hash of issuer name.

methods.name: X509_issuer_name_hash_old
methods.description: Calculates old hash of issuer name.

methods.name: X509_get_subject_name
methods.description: Retrieves the subject name from an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_get_serialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number from an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_get0_serialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number (const) from an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_subject_name_hash
methods.description: Calculates hash of subject name.

methods.name: X509_subject_name_hash_old
methods.description: Calculates old hash of subject name.

methods.name: X509_cmp
methods.description: Compares two X509 certificates for equality.

methods.name: X509_NAME_cmp
methods.description: Compares two X509_NAME structures.

methods.name: X509_NAME_hash
methods.description: Hashes an X509_NAME structure.

methods.name: X509_NAME_hash_old
methods.description: Hashes an X509_NAME structure using MD5.

methods.name: X509_find_by_issuer_and_serial
methods.description: Finds an X509 certificate in a stack by issuer name and serial number.

methods.name: X509_find_by_subject
methods.description: Finds an X509 certificate in a stack by subject name.

methods.name: X509_get_pubkey
methods.description: Retrieves the public key from an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_get0_pubkey_bitstr
methods.description: Retrieves the public key bit string from an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_check_private_key
methods.description: Checks if the private key matches the public key in the X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_chain_up_ref
methods.description: Duplicates a chain of X509 certificates, increasing reference counts.
